name: Terminal Service
description: WebSocket-based shell daemon — the reference/example service for user-specs/002-service-daemons, bundled with its own Terminal app under app/.

port.description: WebSocket port. Set to 0 to let the OS assign a free port (the actual port is then published to runtime.json).

host.description: Interface to bind. Use 0.0.0.0 to allow external connections.
